name: morphing-text
title: Morphing Text
description: Words melt into each other in a loop: the old word blurs away while the next one forms through a gooey threshold filter (1.5 s morph, 0.5 s pause).

moworks.author: magicui
moworks.call: MW.morphingText(q(".mw-morphing-text"), tl, 0, { texts: ["Xin chào", "Thiết kế", "Chuyển động", "Ra mắt"], cycles: 4 });

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: The SVG filter is added once to the page (#mw-morph-threshold). Text 40 pt / 6 rem bold as upstream; leading none: give the holder a height.
